reader_summary: This is the Liao monk Xilin's continuation of the Buddhist sound-and-meaning lexicon, from a Japanese typeset reprint. The transcription keeps the headwords in places but scrambles or drops much of the small-print glosses and fanqie. One page is headed with the title of a different book. Most of the English follows the garble or invents its own sense, and a reader cannot rely on it.
book_verdict: Right text, but none of the four pages has usable OCR: glosses are garbled, entries dropped, a page carries another work's title, and the English is word salad or invents meaning. Not fit to show.

title: 御定孝經衍義·卷八~卷十二 (vol 32)

reader_summary: This is the Qing imperial Elaboration of the Classic of Filial Piety (juan 9–11), from the Siku Quanshu manuscript. The transcription is of the right text and mostly accurate, but interlinear small-print notes are sometimes merged or dropped and a few names are misread. The English is a readable, generally faithful rendering. Check names and notes against the image.
book_verdict: A sound page-by-page reading of the main text with moderate slips (dropped interlinear notes, a misread name, one invented clause from a misread character). Usable with a caveat.

reader_summary: This is the preface and opening juan of Xilin's Continued Sounds and Meanings, from a Japanese typeset reprint. The preface prose is transcribed fairly well. The dictionary pages are scrambled: entries are rewritten as words not on the page, and lines are repeated. The English either mirrors the garble or leaves out most of a page.
book_verdict: The preface prose is mostly right, but the lexicon pages carry invented entries, wrong glosses (stomach for chest bone), model commentary in the OCR, and a translation that drops most of a page. Not fit to show.

reader_summary: This is Zhao Jixu's Qing-era critique of Yijing diagrams, juan 15–20, from the Siku Quanshu manuscript. The prose pages are transcribed accurately and translated reliably, apart from a misread hexagram name. The hexagram-relation tables are not reliable: relations are swapped, invented or inverted. One page carries an invented running title.
book_verdict: Prose pages are good and showable. The table page (p61) is seriously wrong against the image, and headers are sometimes invented, so show it with a warning about tables.
